scripts.build: bun run --filter './packages/ui' build && bun run --filter './apps/desktop' build
scripts.dev: bun run --filter './packages/ui' build && bun run --filter './apps/desktop' dev
scripts.test: bun test packages apps plugins --path-ignore-patterns='plugins/quirky.git/**' && bun test plugins/quirky.git --path-ignore-patterns='plugins/quirky.git/test/window/**' && bun test plugins/quirky.git/test/window
